name: Newmalayalam Steel Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2017, Newmalayalam Steel Ltd manufactures galvanised pipes, tubes, and sheets[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
NMSL manufactures galvanised pipes, tubes, and sheets under the brand name Demac Steel. The products are designed to provide solution to the continuous damage caused to houses in Kerala due to inclement weather condition

pros: Stock is trading at 0.70 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 11.2% over last 3 years.
